plan.notes: Official CSUDH Academic Catalog 2025-2026, History B.A. program page, general '4-Year Roadmap' (Plan of Study Grid), Total Hours 120. All semester sums reconcile with printed Hours. 'Or' rows modeled as choice slots with code = first-listed course per convention. Genuine catalog anomalies kept verbatim: (1) 'GE Area 2 Mathematical Concepts and Quantative Reasoning' — 'Quantative' is the catalog's spelling, kept as printed; (2) Second Year Fall lists 'GE Area 5C: Laboratory' at 3 units (a lab is normally 1 unit) — kept at 3 because the printed Hours for the semester is 15 and 3+3+3+3+3=15 only with 3; the Education option roadmap on the same page lists GE 5C Laboratory at 1, confirming this is a genuine catalog inconsistency, not a transcription error. HIS 400 (Proseminar in History) is the GWAR-certifying course per the roadmap footnote. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented.
